typography.font_family: "Alibaba PuHuiTi 2.0", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

fields.name: type
fields.description: Type of resource (video, practice, guide, etc.)

fields.name: isTrial
fields.description: Whether the resource is available as a free trial

fields.name: valueTag
fields.description: Value tag (exam key point, difficulty, etc.)

fields.name: coverUrl
fields.description: Cover image URL for video resources

fields.name: pageCount
fields.description: Number of pages in a guide resource

fields.name: paragraphCount
fields.description: Number of paragraphs in read_text resources

fields.name: hookType
fields.description: Premium hook type for premium_hook resources

fields.name: targetCourse
fields.description: Target course name for premium hook

fields.name: firstPublishAt
fields.description: First publish timestamp (ISO8601) for NEW badge calculation

fields.name: videoTimepoint
fields.description: Video playback progress in seconds for resume

fields.name: isContainNote
fields.description: Whether the resource contains class notes

fields.name: isPremium
fields.description: Whether the resource is premium (paid) content

fields.name: level
fields.description: Hierarchy level: chapter, section, or subsection

fields.name: isExpanded
fields.description: Whether the tree node is expanded

fields.name: isHaveNew
fields.description: Whether this node contains NEW content (bubble-up marker)

fields.name: firstPublishAt
fields.description: First publish timestamp (ISO8601) for sidebar NEW dot

fields.name: displayName
fields.description: Full display name for the textbook

fields.name: nodeId
fields.description: Resource/node ID this progress belongs to

fields.name: lastUpdateTime
fields.description: Last update timestamp in ISO8601 format

fields.name: reviewLearningMode
fields.description: Review scene learning order preference: quiz-first, video-first, or ask-every-time

fields.name: defaultSceneTab
fields.description: Default scene tab on page load: 'all' or 'last-selected'

fields.name: practiceDifficulties
fields.description: Default practice difficulty levels (multi-select: basic, medium, hard)

fields.name: lastSelectedTab
fields.description: Last selected scene tab (persisted for 'last-selected' mode)

fields.name: key
fields.description: Scene type key used for filtering

fields.name: isAvailable
fields.description: Whether available for the current subject

SCIENCE_PROBLEM.description: Science problem-solving subjects with drill and problem-solving scenes

LANGUAGE.description: Language/liberal arts subjects with review and accumulation scenes

SCIENCE_BASIC.description: Basic science subjects with fewer scenes

HISTORY.description: History/politics subjects (scene filtering not yet launched)

state.name: isScrollingByClick
state.description: Lock flag preventing IntersectionObserver conflict during click-to-scroll

state.name: isAllResourcesOpen
state.description: Whether the 'all resources' drawer is open

state.name: rememberReviewMode
state.description: Legacy flag for remembering review mode

state.name: isFirstVisit
state.description: Whether this is the user's first visit (controls first-time guide)

state.name: readResources
state.description: Set of resource IDs the user has already read (for NEW badge)

getters.name: sceneTabs
getters.description: Scene tabs for the current subject from SCENE_CONFIG

getters.name: isEnglish
getters.description: Whether current subject is English (controls vocab entry)

getters.name: isLiberalArts
getters.description: Whether current subject is liberal arts (controls read_text visibility)

getters.name: currentGuide
getters.description: Learning method guide text for current subject + scene combination

getters.name: allSubsections
getters.description: Flattened list of all subsection-level nodes (for scroll observation)

getters.name: currentChapterTitle
getters.description: Title of the first top-level chapter

getters.name: chapterStats
getters.type: { mindMapCount: number; errorBookCount: number; vocabWordCount: number }
getters.description: Chapter-level resource statistics for the current subject

getters.name: adjacentChapters
getters.type: { prev: Chapter | null; next: Chapter | null }
getters.description: Previous and next chapters for footer navigation

actions.name: fetchChapters
actions.description: Load chapter data for the current textbook (async with simulated delay)

actions.name: switchTextbook
actions.description: Switch textbook and reload chapters; resets tab if current tab is invalid for new subject

actions.name: selectNode
actions.description: Select a subsection node by ID

actions.name: toggleExpand
actions.description: Toggle the expanded state of a chapter/section node

actions.name: switchTab
actions.description: Switch the active scene tab; auto-closes all-resources drawer

actions.name: unlockVip
actions.description: Set VIP status to true (simulated purchase)

actions.name: updateProgress
actions.description: Update progress for a resource (auto-derives status from percentage)

actions.name: setScrollingByClick
actions.description: Set the scroll-lock flag to prevent observer conflicts

actions.name: loadReviewModePreference
actions.description: Load review learning mode preference from localStorage

actions.name: saveReviewModePreference
actions.description: Save review learning mode preference to localStorage

actions.name: shouldShowLearningModeModal
actions.description: Returns true if the learning mode modal should be shown (when set to ask-every-time)

actions.name: updateAppSettings
actions.description: Merge partial settings update and persist to localStorage

actions.name: recordLastSelectedTab
actions.description: Record the last selected tab for 'last-selected' default mode

actions.name: restorePosition
actions.description: Restore scroll position via priority chain: URL params > server API > localStorage > default first subsection

actions.name: markAsRead
actions.description: Mark a resource as read (removes NEW badge)

actions.name: completeGuide
actions.description: Mark the first-time guide as completed, persists to localStorage

actions.name: isNewContent
actions.description: Check if a resource qualifies as NEW (published within 7 days and not yet read)

components.name: App
components.description: Root application shell, renders ChapterList as the sole view

components.name: ChapterList
components.description: Main page view with sidebar + content layout. Manages sidebar toggle, settings view, and first-time guide overlay. Initializes data on mount.

components.name: GlobalHeader
components.description: Top header bar with back button, branded title, textbook context selector, and VIP upgrade entry

components.name: FunctionBar

events.name: open-settings
events.description: Emitted when user clicks the settings button

components.description: Function bar below header containing scene tabs (left) and quick action entries (right): mind map, error book, favorites, settings. Desktop shows all actions; mobile collapses into a dropdown menu.

components.name: ContextSelector

props.name: compact
props.description: Compact mode shows only subject name instead of full textbook info

components.description: Textbook context selector with pill button trigger and a 3-column modal (subject, edition, grade/semester). Teleported to body.

components.name: SceneTabs

props.name: embedded
props.description: Embedded mode uses pill-style tabs without bottom border; non-embedded uses sticky header with indicator

components.description: Scene tab switcher with a fixed 'All Resources' tab on the left, a divider, and scrollable scene-specific tabs. Tabs are driven by store.sceneTabs (subject-dependent).

components.name: ChapterTree

props.name: chapters
props.description: Array of chapter nodes to render

events.name: node-click
events.description: Emitted when a subsection node is clicked

components.description: Recursive chapter tree for the sidebar. Only subsection-level nodes are clickable. Click triggers scroll-lock, node selection, and smooth scrolling to the corresponding resource section. Shows NEW dot badges on subsection/section nodes.

components.name: ResourceList

props.name: mode
props.description: Display mode: 'scene' filters by current tab, 'all' shows all resources

events.name: scroll-to-node
events.description: Emitted when a node scroll event occurs

components.description: Main content area rendering resources grouped by subsection. Uses IntersectionObserver for scroll-to-highlight sync. Supports practice+guide pair layout (50/50 side-by-side). Filters resources by scene and subject. Manages LearningModeModal and ContentChoiceModal states.

components.name: LearningGuide
components.description: Collapsible learning method guide panel at the top of the resource list. Shows subject+scene-specific guidance text. Uses warm orange background.

components.name: KnowledgeCard

events.name: request-learning-mode
events.description: Emitted when user clicks in review scene with ask-every-time setting

events.name: request-content-choice
events.description: Emitted when user clicks a video with partial progress (0 < progress < 100)

components.description: Video knowledge point card with cover image, title, category/value/difficulty tags, VIP badge (lock/trial/unlocked priority), NEW badge, and dual segment-bar progress (video + quiz). Handles review scene learning mode and content choice modal triggers.

components.name: PracticeCard
components.description: Practice/drill card with icon, title, difficulty level indicators (segmented underlines), and progress display (completed/total). Supports paired layout mode (50% width alongside GuideCard) with container queries for responsive tiers.

components.name: GuideCard

props.name: resource
props.description: Guide (study plan) resource data to display

components.description: Study guide card with blue gradient icon, title, page count, and download action. Supports paired layout mode alongside PracticeCard.

components.name: ReadTextCard
components.description: Read-aloud card for liberal arts subjects. Warm gradient background with paragraph count, estimated time, and microphone action button.

components.name: SummaryNoteCard

props.name: resource
props.description: Summary note resource data to display

components.description: AI-generated summary note card with green gradient background, note count, AI badge (sparkle icon).

components.name: PremiumHookCard

props.name: resource
props.description: Premium hook resource data to display

components.description: Premium/advanced course hook card with gold gradient cover, category tag, difficulty stars, question count, and purchase button. Only shown in the 'extra' scene.

components.name: NewBadge

props.name: id
props.description: Resource or node ID for read-status lookup

props.name: firstPublishAt
props.description: First publish timestamp (ISO8601) for freshness calculation

props.name: size
props.description: Display size: 'resource' shows 'NEW' pill badge, 'dot' shows a small red dot

components.description: NEW content badge indicator. Shows 'NEW' pill or red dot based on size prop. Visible when firstPublishAt is within 7 days and user has not read the resource.

components.name: ChapterFooter
components.description: Bottom navigation for previous/next chapter. Shows chapter titles with arrow icons. Navigates to the first subsection of the target chapter on click.

components.name: ContentChoiceModal

props.name: resourceTitle
props.description: Title of the resource being acted upon

props.name: hasNote
props.description: Whether to show the 'view class notes' option (requires isContainNote)

events.name: select
events.description: Emitted when user selects a learning content option

components.description: Modal for choosing learning content when a video has partial progress. Options: continue video, do supplementary practice, view class notes (conditional). Teleported to body with bottom-sheet animation.

components.name: LearningModeModal

props.name: resourceTitle
props.description: Title of the resource being acted upon

events.name: confirm
events.description: Emitted when user confirms their learning mode selection

components.description: Modal for selecting review learning mode (quiz-first recommended, or video-first). Shown in review scene when appSettings.reviewLearningMode is 'ask-every-time'. Defaults to quiz-first. Teleported to body.

components.name: FirstTimeGuide

events.name: complete
events.description: Emitted when user finishes or skips the guide

components.description: 3-step onboarding guide overlay. Steps: 1) Select textbook, 2) Choose chapter, 3) Click subsection to learn. Shows step indicators, gesture animation placeholder, and skip/next buttons. Persists completion to localStorage. Teleported to body.

components.name: SettingsPage

events.name: back
events.description: Emitted when user clicks the back button to return to the chapter list

components.description: Full-page settings view with 3 sections: review learning order (radio: quiz-first/video-first/ask-every-time), default scene tab (radio: all/last-selected), practice difficulty (checkbox: basic/medium/hard, min 1). Auto-saves to localStorage.

responsive_rules.name: desktop
responsive_rules.behavior: Sidebar always visible at 260px. Action buttons shown inline in FunctionBar. Context selector shows full textbook info. Textbook modal centered with border-radius.

responsive_rules.name: mobile
responsive_rules.behavior: Sidebar hidden off-screen (translateX -100%), toggled via pull-handle button at 61.8% vertical position. Overlay shown when sidebar is open. Content area takes full width with pan-y touch action.

responsive_rules.name: small_mobile
responsive_rules.behavior: FunctionBar quick actions collapse into a dropdown menu. Scene tabs reduce padding/gap. Context selector truncates text. Textbook modal selector columns stack vertically.

responsive_rules.name: tiny_mobile
responsive_rules.behavior: Scene tabs further reduce padding and font size.

responsive_rules.name: micro_mobile
responsive_rules.behavior: VIP upgrade button hides text label, shows icon only.

responsive_rules.name: phone_landscape
responsive_rules.behavior: Vocab entry compresses padding and switches to horizontal layout.

responsive_rules.name: container_query_pair_row
responsive_rules.behavior: PracticeCard+GuideCard paired layout. Tier 1 (<=350px): icons shrink to 24px, type label smaller. Tier 2 (<=300px): type label hidden, subtitle promoted to primary title, icons shrink to 20px.

click_to_scroll.description: When user clicks a subsection in the sidebar tree, the content area scrolls smoothly to the corresponding resource group
click_to_scroll.mechanism: Sets isScrollingByClick=true before scrolling, resets after 600ms to prevent IntersectionObserver from overriding the selection during the scroll animation

scroll_to_highlight.description: When user scrolls the resource list, the sidebar tree automatically highlights the currently visible subsection
scroll_to_highlight.mechanism: IntersectionObserver watches all .subsection-group elements. When a subsection enters the detection zone (top 10%-15% of viewport), its ID is used to update selectedNodeId. Skipped when isScrollingByClick is true.

vip_logic.badge_new_interaction: When badge-unlocked and content is NEW, hide badge-unlocked to let NEW badge show. When badge-lock is active, hide NEW badge.
vip_logic.locked_behavior: Non-free resources show lock badge and trigger VIP purchase confirmation on click
vip_logic.trial_behavior: isTrial resources show 'free trial' badge and allow access regardless of VIP status
vip_logic.upgrade_entry: GlobalHeader contains VIP upgrade button with gold gradient. Changes to gray when isVip=true.

new_badge_logic.calculation: Resource qualifies as NEW when: (1) firstPublishAt is defined, (2) user has not read it (not in readResources set), (3) days since firstPublishAt <= 7

display_sizes.resource: Red pill badge with 'NEW' text on resource cards
display_sizes.dot: Small 8px red dot on sidebar tree nodes (subsection/section level)

new_badge_logic.read_tracking: readResources Set<string> persisted to localStorage key 'read_resources'
new_badge_logic.mark_as_read: store.markAsRead(nodeId) adds to set and persists

resource_layout.single_row: Most resource cards take full width of the content area
resource_layout.pair_row: Adjacent practice + guide resources are laid out side-by-side (50/50) in a .resource-pair-row container with container queries for responsive adaptation
resource_layout.scene_filtering: Resources without scenes default to preview/review. read_text only shows for liberal arts subjects.

localStorage_keys.description: Array of read resource IDs for NEW badge tracking

changelog.changes: Initial SDD from V1.0 prototype: basic chapter tree, video cards, scene tabs, sidebar scroll sync

Complete rewrite for V1.6: 4 scene templates (SCIENCE_PROBLEM, LANGUAGE, SCIENCE_BASIC, HISTORY), 9 resource types (video, practice, guide, read_text, summary_note, premium_hook, recite, mind_map, error_book), ContentChoiceModal, LearningModeModal, FirstTimeGuide 3-step onboarding, ChapterFooter prev/next navigation, ContextSelector 3-column textbook modal, NEW badge system (7-day window + read tracking), VIP badge priority logic, AppSettings persistence, practice+guide paired layout with container queries, position restore priority chain, responsive rules for 7 breakpoints
